messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: inference-api-prod latency p99 = 2200ms (SLO p99 = 1000ms). Triggered 3x in 5m. Dash: https://dash.redwood/infer/alerts/7723456789
oncall-jamie: acked, looking now
oncall-jamie: p95 ~760ms, p99 ~2200ms, spike started ~3m ago. eu-west worst hit
ops-lee: is autoscaler healthy? any OOMs / node churn?
eng-chris: quick log peek: `2026-03-17T15:03:12Z inference: kvcache miss_rate=82% batch_q=large backlog=140` — KV cache warmup looks stalled
sre-maya: autoscaler at 100% on eu-nodepool, pod CPU ~95% but GPU util low. Looks like long queueing not compute-bound
oncall-jamie: initiating mitigation: route a canary to fallback-model-small in eu-west, reduce max_batch_size
ops-lee: +1. command: `redwood route set inference-api-prod --model fallback-small --region eu-west --canary 10%`
eng-chris: running canary now (10%)
incident-bot: Page update: acknowledged by oncall-jamie
support-raj: any customer-facing errors showing? 5xx spikes?
oncall-jamie: minimal 5xx so far, mostly latency. Top customer sessions report UI lag but not timeouts yet
pm-ana: prepare a short status note in case error rate crosses threshold (>5% increase)
sre-maya: autoscaler logs: `scale_event: denied: inflight=24/max=24`. Hitting control-plane quota for scale-outs
ops-lee: can we borrow capacity from dedicated-eu pool for short burst? I can request via infra API
oncall-jamie: requesting burst: `infra-ctl reserve --pool dedicated-eu --minutes 30` — request sent
eng-chris: also kicking off KV prefix prewarm: `scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --service inference-api-prod --shards 8`
oncall-jamie: prewarm started
incident-bot: Routing change deployed: canary 10% -> acked
ops-lee: monitoring p99 on canary: dropped 2200ms -> 900ms, good sign
oncall-jamie: promoting canary to 50% while we watch
support-raj: noting customer impact: 2 customers reached out reporting UI lag, CS notified
pm-ana: drafting status: "Investigating elevated latency for inference requests in eu-west; mitigation in progress."
oncall-jamie: will watch for 15m; if stable we'll close page and publish update
eng-chris: leaving logs for postmortem:
```
2026-03-17T15:06:10Z prewarm: started shard 3
2026-03-17T15:07:05Z route: canary promoted 50%
2026-03-17T15:08:48Z p99: 890ms
```
incident-bot: Page resolved by oncall-jamie (manual mitigation: routing fallback + prewarm) :white_check_mark:
oncall-jamie: closing incident thread; follow-up RCA to include autoscaler quota fix + prewarm step in deploys
sre-maya: action: raise control-plane quota or change autoscaler heuristic to detect nodepool saturation earlier
ops-lee: I'll follow up on dedicated-eu burst policy and pre-approve small cushion for deploys
support-raj: thanks team — CS will update affected customers with the status note
pm-ana: thanks — please ping when RCA draft is ready
oncall-jamie: handing off to @eng-chris to draft RCA, marking incident.incident.p1 -> review
eng-chris: ack, starting RCA draft and will ping for reviews in #eng-postmortems
_metadata_note: Single-string Slack thread; messages in chronological order, prefixed by sender name. No title field per agents.md.
